{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''waiter droid''' served customers at the [[Stone Grotto]] dinner club in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Drev'starn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the [[Service droid/Legends|droid]] waited on a table of undercover [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s, mistaking [[Unidentified courier lookalike|one of them]] for a [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|courier]] associated with a crime syndicate who was dining at the club at the same [[Time/Legends|time]]. At first the droid thought that the customer changed their order, and also wondered when they changed tables.

Right when the droid was talking about it, the Rebels witnessed an ensuing hostage situation between the Intelligence operatives and two [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian kidnapper|kidnappers]].
